title: Stop at the first leaf
invariant: FIFO order removes nodes in nondecreasing depth, so the first node without children gives minimum leaf depth.

frames.explanation: The root enters the FIFO queue at depth zero. An empty tree starts with an empty queue and result.

scene.description: normal tree after init; queue [0]; current index -1; depth 0; level []; result 0

frames.explanation: Freeze the queue length before processing depth 1. Only those nodes belong to this level; newly added children wait.

scene.description: normal tree after level_start; queue [0]; current index -1; depth 1; level []; result 0

frames.explanation: Remove node index 0 with value 7, then append its existing children left to right. The queue becomes [1,2].

scene.description: normal tree after visit; queue [1,2]; current index 0; depth 1; level []; result 0

frames.explanation: Freeze the queue length before processing depth 2. Only those nodes belong to this level; newly added children wait.

frames.explanation: Remove node index 1 with value 3, then append its existing children left to right. The queue becomes [2,3,4].

frames.explanation: Node index 2 has no children. All shallower nodes were removed first, so depth 2 is the minimum leaf depth.
